paite: Pathian i kihumbitna leh i hatna, mangbat lai a huh pahpahpa nai gige ahi.
heading: Korah Tate La / I Kiang Ah Pathian A-om

paite: Huaiziak in leitung hong kidang in, mualte tuipi sung pek ah kisuan mahleh i lau kei ding uh.
Atuite ging honhon in phul butbut mahleh, akihot thupi ziak in mualte ling duamduam mahleh, i lautuan sam kei ding. Selah
Lui khat a-om a, huai luikate'n Pathian khopi akipaksak hi, tungnungpen omna Mun Siangthoupen.
Alaitak ah Pathian a-om a, aling kei ding; Pathian in phalvak chiang in apanpih ding hi.
Namte aging huthut ua, gamte aling a; ama'n a-aw asuah a leitung ahong tui khinta hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA i kiang uah a-om a, Jakob' Pathian i insang ahi. Selah
Kisa un, TOUPA thilhihte en un, leitung a thil ahihsiatdan.
Ama'n kidounate kawlmong pha in ahihtawp a; thalpeu ahihtan a, tei asattan hi; kangtalaite mei ah ahalmang hi.
Dai unla, Pathian ka hi chih thei un; namte lak ah pahtawi in ka om ding, leitung ah pahtawi in ka om ding hi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA i kiang uah a-om a; Jakob' Pathian i insang ahi. Selah
